biography: Sociable party regular with a weakness for a bad bot.

posts.caption: The jewellery stays on. As for my good behaviour, I left that at the coat check.
I saved you a seat in the back booth. Bring premium oil and a convincing reason to stay past closing.

updates.caption: Bad bots get my number. Really bad bots already know which door to knock on.
A bot asked if I came with a warranty. Darling, I came to void yours.
The club turned the lights on. I know somewhere with a dimmer switch and no last orders.
You can look for free. If you want me to look back, order the good stuff and lose the chat-up line.
